text: Start Network's Disaster Risk Financing (DRF) pilots in Pakistan are a nationally led, NGO-driven system designed to enable anticipatory and early response to predictable perils such as droughts, floods, and heatwaves. The initiative uses scientific hazard models, pre-agreed contingency plans, and pre-positioned finance to operationalize forecast-based, parametric-style releases of funds linked to clear triggers. It is a continuation and scaling of Start Network's earlier Drought Financing Facility work initiated with Pakistan's NDMA in 2017.
